text.en:
Project B-028.17, title B of Republic Act Numbered One thousand four hundred eleven, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Project B-028.17—Mogpog-Hightown-Danao Road Improvement 20,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
